budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager confirmed the town would receive the full amount earmarked for the fuel tank replacement, with work to begin in a couple of weeks.
budget_items.quote: i did get confirmation that we would get the full $165,000 earmarked for the fuel tank replacement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager said department heads were notified of a spending freeze for the rest of FY20 on non-essential items and hiring, excluding grant funds.
budget_items.quote: i have notified department heads that there would be a spending freeze for the remainder of fy20

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Finance Director is preparing revenue projections for the rest of this year and next fiscal year; the town will receive its local aid payments for the remainder of the year.
budget_items.quote: receive our local aid payments for the remainder of the year

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY21 budget process is being started from scratch because of the pandemic, and the financial impact still needs research.
budget_items.quote: we are going to have to start the budget process from scratch due to this event

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Due to fiscal uncertainty, the Town Manager suggested holding off or doing a very limited scope with the design firm.
budget_items.quote: i suggested due to uncertainty in the current fiscal arena that we hold off or do a very limited scope with the design firm

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed bond anticipation notes for the Saliba property purchase loan and the ladder truck borrowing.
budget_items.quote: sign the bond anticipation notes for the saliba property purchase loan as well the ladder truck borrowing

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Adams noted that one date for both elections was better and saved money.
budget_items.quote: one date for both elections was better for less gatherings of that many people and saved money

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Expenses such as IT equipment are being tracked, and volunteer meals-on-wheels hours are reimbursable under the emergency declaration.
budget_items.quote: those types of hours are reimbursable

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A public commenter said the United Way's Covid-19 Stand United Fund had raised over $60,000 so far; it is not a town fund.
budget_items.quote: they have raised over $60,000 so far.
